integrity: Analytical proof for all group orders and all real-linear operators. Finite reproducibility checks are diagnostics, not an exhaustive certificate. Bibliographic claims are restricted to verifiable sources.
scientific_limitations: Real two-dimensional Euclidean operator space and canonical subgroup actions only; no higher-dimensional, non-Euclidean or complex analogue. Infinite-subgroup qualitative value agrees with general prior transitivity mechanisms. Earlier rank-one calculations are explicitly credited rather than claimed anew. Novelty is conditional on accessible comparison; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Unrestricted group numerical indices of the Euclidean plane for every orthogonal subgroup
